pages.title: The Highlands' own
text: Among the stone, moss and groves of the Highlands live two heavy grazers, a drifting floater, and a hunter that comes out at night.

Every gentle beast here can be brushed for its reagent once a minute, and is tempted and bred with its own food, named under **Hunting and herding** below. It can be bonded like any gentle animal (see [familiars](familiars)), though none of them has a familiar gift of its own.

pages.title: Cragcoat
text: A shaggy, armoured grazer in herds of two to four. **30 health** and **7 armour**, and slow.
It drops **1 to 3 Crag Fleece**, more with Looting.

pages.title: Bouldersnout
text: A tusked, rock-hided grazer, in herds of two to four. **30 health** and **4 armour**.

pages.title: Updrifter
text: A pale floater that drifts over the slopes in ones to threes. **12 health**, no armour.

pages.title: Scree Lurcher
text: A tall, stony thing that rises on the open ground at night, one to three at a time. It has **32 health** and **3 armour** and hits for **6**, and every blow shoves you back.
It drops **1 to 2 Scree Knuckles**, a Shove reagent.

pages.title: Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, each one drops more when hunted, and more again with Looting. Meat drops roasted if the animal died burning. To breed wild ones, **sneak** while you feed two adults their food; fed normally, a wild one warms to you instead.
- **Cragcoat**: 1 to 3 Raw Game and up to 2 March Leather. Breed with **wheat**.
- **Bouldersnout**: 1 to 3 Raw Game and up to 2 March Leather. Breed with **potatoes or carrots**.
- **Updrifter**: up to 2 String. Breed with **Ley Thistle**.
- **Scree Lurcher**: 1 to 2 Flint and up to 2 Iron Nuggets.
